verdict.rationale: Sentry's AI agent monitoring includes an LLM Calls view that compares models, prompts, token usage, cost and response performance across production requests. That is production observability, not a feature for running evals or comparing eval runs side by side. The evidence never mentions eval runs, datasets, scoring, or regression comparison between prompt or model versions, so the LLM Calls view is only an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can compare eval runs side by side to catch regressions between prompt or model versions
